page_title: WOL 2-2 CRY | Wolves v Crystal Palace 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Crystal Palace due to a foul in the build-up play.
90+6' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90+5' Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:2.
90+5' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+5' This shall not pass! Mario Lemina (Wolves) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
90' Substitution. Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) in, Ismaila Sarr out.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
88' Yellow card! It's like Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Anthony Taylor agrees and books him.
87' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Dean Henderson as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
84' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Eddie Nketiah and he is replaced by Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Will Hughes as he is replaced by Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace).
79' The foul by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
77' 2 - 2 Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
76' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is about to take a corner kick.

76' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the roof of the net lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Jose Sa.

75' Jose Sa pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the left post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.

72' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Goncalo Guedes, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Joao Gomes (Wolves), who beats Dean Henderson with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
67' 1 - 1 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
63' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
63' Substitution. Toti is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
62' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Thomas Doyle is replaced by Mario Lemina (Wolves).
62' A substitution has been made. Pablo Sarabia goes off and Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) comes on.
60' 0 - 1 Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) is quickest to the rebound inside the penalty area, and he plants a header directly into the middle of the net.
60' It seemed like Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

59' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Anthony Taylor with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Crystal Palace, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
58' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
57' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
56' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
56' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace win a corner kick.
54' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Dean Henderson keeps it out.
53' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
51' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is able to continue to play.
50' The game is interrupted now, Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

49' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Dean Henderson with a fabulous save.
48' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Wolves will take a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
43' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
41' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
37' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) who loops his header high over the bar.
36' Flag up against Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
35' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
35' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) got to the ball inside the six-yard box all of a sudden and slammed it towards the goal, but unfortunately hits one of his teammates instead of scoring.
33' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Dean Henderson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
30' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
28' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.

28' Jose Sa pulls off a great save to deny Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
28' The linesman raises his flag. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is adjudged offside.
26' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
24' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick.
23' Poor challenge! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Wolves are awarded a free kick.
21' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
20' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
20' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

19' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' The ball is cleared after Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
14' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' The resulting corner from Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.

9' Wolves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.

7' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Jose Sa, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
6' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
6' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.

5' It looks like Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
3' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

2' The game is interrupted. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Wolves in a dangerous position.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
